mainFlow.description: Planner authors a traced Epic delta and role packets.
Personas execute their frozen role packets.
Reviewer and tester publish contract-bound evidence.
The authority path converges the Epic to a terminal state.

postconditions: The Epic is done or failed honestly with durable evidence.
preconditions: A frozen current Project Baseline exists.
Repository and persona readiness checks pass.
title: Epic 자동 전달 검증 / Validate autonomous Epic delivery
